questions.question_en: A guest says: "My uncle passed away yesterday. We need something for the wake hall." What should you do first?
questions.question_zh: 客人说：「我叔叔昨天去世了，治丧处需要东西。」你首先该怎么做？
options_en: Offer condolences first, then ask if they need a standing wreath for the wake.
Suggest a refined bouquet of roses.
Tell them to check Google reviews before ordering.
Immediately recommend the largest wreath and ask for budget.
options_zh: 先慰问，再询问是否需要治丧处的庄重花圈。
叫他们先看Google评价再下单。
马上推荐最大花圈并问预算。
questions.explanation_en: Always start with condolences for funeral matters. Then qualify for standing wreaths or mourning baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 丧事一律先慰问。再确认是否需要庄重立式花圈或哀悼花篮。

questions.question_en: A local florist messages: "I need a lot of foliage for next week's event." Which line fits?
questions.question_zh: 本地花店说：「下周活动我需要很多叶材。」适合哪条业务线？
options_en: Opening baskets
Wholesale flowers by pre-order
Condolence wreaths
Refined bouquets
questions.explanation_en: Bulk flowers and foliage for florists and event teams are wholesale by pre-order.
questions.explanation_zh: 花店与活动团队的散装鲜花与叶材属于预订制批发。

questions.question_en: A couple says they need bridal bouquet, car flowers, an arch and full on-site setup. What do you recommend?
questions.question_zh: 新人说需要手捧花、婚车、拱门和全案现场布置。你推荐什么？
options_en: Wholesale bulk only
Only a refined bouquet
Wedding and event full design with on-site installation
Opening basket with money tree
options_zh: 婚礼与活动全案设计与现场布置
questions.explanation_en: Bridal items, arches and on-site setup belong to wedding and event full design.
questions.explanation_zh: 手捧花、拱门与现场布置属于婚礼与活动全案设计。

questions.question_en: Someone is moving to a new house and wants a congratulatory arrangement with a ribbon. Best match?
questions.question_zh: 有人乔迁，想要带祝贺布条的摆设。最合适？
options_en: Wholesale foliage
Only table flowers for a wedding
Condolence wreath
Opening basket that can include money tree or lucky bamboo
options_zh: 可搭配发财树或开运竹的开张花篮
questions.explanation_en: Housewarmings and openings use large festive baskets with optional ribbons and trees.
questions.explanation_zh: 乔迁与开幕使用大型喜庆花篮，可加祝贺布条与树。

questions.question_en: Guest sends a photo and says "Make it exactly like this." Correct reply?
questions.question_zh: 客人发图说「照这张做」。正确回复？
options_en: This is for style reference only. Flower types and colours will adjust to seasonal supply. I will confirm with you first.
We cannot accept any photos.
The price will be higher if we follow the photo.
Yes, we will copy it exactly with the same flowers.
options_zh: 仅供风格参考。花材与颜色依当季供应调整，我会先跟你确认。
questions.explanation_en: Photos are style reference only. Must inform that materials adjust by season.
questions.explanation_zh: 图片仅风格参考。必须告知花材依当季调整。

questions.question_en: Guest asks for blue hydrangeas shown in their photo. What do you do?
questions.question_zh: 客人要求图里的蓝色绣球。你怎么做？
options_en: Promise blue hydrangeas without checking.
Explain that colour depends on seasonal supply and say you will confirm with the company.
Say the company never uses hydrangeas.
Invent that blue is in stock.
options_zh: 不确认就承诺蓝色绣球。
说明颜色视当季供应，并说你帮跟公司确认。
questions.explanation_en: Never invent stock. Inform about seasonal adjustment and confirm when needed.
questions.explanation_zh: 绝不虚构库存。告知当季调整，需要时帮确认。

questions.question_en: Which statement about customer photos is correct?
questions.question_zh: 关于客人图片，哪句正确？
options_en: Ignore the photo and suggest something else immediately.
We always match them exactly.
Use as style reference only and must tell the guest about seasonal changes.
Photos guarantee the flowers are in stock.
options_zh: 忽略图片马上建议别的。
仅作风格参考，必须告知当季调整。
questions.explanation_en: Style reference only; finished product follows seasonal supply; inform first.
questions.explanation_zh: 仅风格参考；成品依当季花材；必须先告知。

questions.question_en: You are about to send a quote. The guest earlier sent a reference photo. What must you include?
questions.question_zh: 你准备申请报价，客人之前发了参考图。必须包含什么？
options_en: A fixed price you invented.
Nothing about the photo.
A promise of exact match.
A clear note that the photo is style reference and flowers may differ by season.
options_zh: 明确说明图片仅风格参考，花材可能因当季不同。
questions.explanation_en: Must inform about style reference and seasonal adjustment before proceeding.
questions.explanation_zh: 进行前必须告知风格参考与当季调整。

questions.question_en: Guest says: "I saw negative reviews on Google." Best reply?
questions.question_zh: 客人说：「我在Google看到负评。」最好回复？
options_en: We take feedback seriously and focus on fresh flowers and on-time delivery. If you have a specific concern, I can help confirm with the company.
Change the subject quickly.
Badmouth the people who left reviews.
Those reviews are all fake.
options_zh: 我们重视反馈，专注新鲜与准时。如有具体问题我帮你跟公司确认。
questions.explanation_en: Be honest, do not badmouth others, offer to confirm if needed.
questions.explanation_zh: 诚实，不贬低他人，需要时帮确认。

questions.question_en: Guest worries the flowers will not be fresh. Correct explanation?
questions.question_zh: 客人担心花不新鲜。正确说明？
options_en: They stay fresh forever.
The company handles import documents and uses air freight to Kuching airport with clearance. Pre-order and inventory checks help reduce waste, but actual condition still needs confirmation.
We only use local flowers that never travel.
Ignore and talk about price.
options_zh: 公司自行处理进口文件，古晋机场空运清关。预订与盘点减少损耗，但实际花况仍要确认。
只用从不运输的本地花。
questions.explanation_en: Explain the process honestly; do not guarantee; confirm actual condition when needed.
questions.explanation_zh: 诚实说明流程；不保证；需要时确认实际花况。

questions.question_en: Guest asks "How much?" What do you say?
questions.question_zh: 客人问「多少钱？」你怎么说？
options_en: Offer a discount without checking.
Give a number you think is fair.
Price is based on the current quote. Tell me the date and your budget, and I will apply for you.
Say it is free for new customers.
options_zh: 报一个你觉得合理的数字。
价格以当下报价为准。告诉我日期和预算，我帮你申请。
questions.explanation_en: Never invent price. Agent applies for current quote after asking date and budget.
questions.explanation_zh: 绝不编造价格。问日期和预算后由Agent申请当下报价。

questions.question_en: Guest says the delivery area is too far. What is appropriate?
questions.question_zh: 客人说配送太远。合适做法？
options_en: Refuse immediately.
Invent a closer pickup point.
Promise same-day delivery anywhere.
Check if the place is in the listed areas (Kuching, Matang, Batu Kawa, etc.) and say you will confirm stock and schedule with the company.
options_zh: 虚构一个更近的取货点。
承诺任何地方当日送达。
确认是否在配送区域（古晋、Matang、Batu Kawa等），并说帮跟公司确认库存与排期。
questions.explanation_en: Delivery is subject to stock and schedule in the listed areas. Confirm when uncertain.
questions.explanation_zh: 配送视库存与排期，仅限所列区域。不确定就帮确认。

questions.question_en: You hear a neighbour is cutting the ribbon for a new shop tomorrow. What opportunity is this?
questions.question_zh: 你听到邻居明天新店剪彩。这是什么商机？
options_en: Opening basket with possible ribbon and money tree
Condolence wreath
Wholesale only
Refined bouquet for birthday
options_zh: 可加祝贺布条与发财树的开张花篮
questions.explanation_en: Ribbon-cuttings and openings are leads for festive baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 剪彩与开幕是开张花篮商机。

questions.question_en: A friend mentions their daughter is graduating next month. Suitable lead?
questions.question_zh: 朋友提到女儿下个月毕业。适合的商机？
options_en: Opening basket
Refined bouquet (graduation occasion)
Wholesale foliage
Funeral wreath
questions.explanation_en: Graduation is one of the occasions for refined bouquets.
questions.explanation_zh: 毕业属于精致花束的场合。

questions.question_en: You meet an event planner who regularly needs bulk flowers. What should you note?
questions.question_zh: 你遇到经常需要大量花材的活动策划。应该记下什么？
options_en: Ignore because they are not a couple
Offer only small bouquets
This is a wholesale pre-order opportunity
Suggest condolence wreaths
questions.explanation_en: Event teams and planners needing volume are wholesale leads.
questions.explanation_zh: 需要大量的活动团队与策划是批发商机。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a lead for condolence wreaths?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪项是帛事花圈的商机？
options_en: Mother's Day gift
Wedding car decoration
A new shop opening
A family preparing for a memorial service
questions.explanation_en: Memorials and wake halls are the occasions for condolence wreaths.
questions.explanation_zh: 追悼会与治丧处是帛事花圈场合。

questions.question_en: Guest has not replied for two days after you sent information. Polite follow-up?
questions.question_zh: 客人两天没回你发的信息。礼貌跟进？
options_en: "Just checking if you still need help with the arrangement. Let me know the date and budget when you are ready."
"I will apply for the quote now without your confirmation."
"Why haven't you replied? Are you not interested?"
"You must decide today or the flowers will be gone."
options_zh: 「看看你是否还需要帮忙。准备好时告诉我日期和预算就好。」
「我现在不确认就帮你申请报价。」
questions.explanation_en: Follow up politely, confirm needs, no pressure, no impossible promises.
questions.explanation_zh: 礼貌跟进、确认需求、不施压、不承诺做不到的事。

questions.question_en: Guest says "Maybe next week." How do you close the conversation?
questions.question_zh: 客人说「也许下周」。你怎么结束对话？
options_en: Push them to order today.
"No problem. When you have the date and budget, just message me and I will help apply for the quote."
Promise same-day delivery next week without checking.
Stop replying.
options_zh: 「没问题。有日期和预算时告诉我，我帮你申请报价。」
不确认就承诺下周当日送达。
questions.explanation_en: Leave the door open politely without pressure or unconfirmed promises.
questions.explanation_zh: 礼貌留门，不施压，也不做未确认的承诺。

questions.question_en: After explaining the photo is style reference, the guest is still thinking. Best next step?
questions.question_zh: 解释完图片仅风格参考后，客人还在考虑。最好下一步？
options_en: Tell them the flowers will be exactly as the photo.
Keep sending more photos to pressure them.
Ask if they have a preferred date and budget so you can apply when ready.
Invent a discount to close faster.
options_zh: 告诉他们会跟图片完全一样。
询问是否有日期和预算，准备好时你帮申请。
questions.explanation_en: Confirm needs gently and offer to apply for quote; do not pressure or promise exact match.
questions.explanation_zh: 温和确认需求并提议帮申请报价；不施压也不承诺一模一样。

questions.question_en: Guest asks if you can guarantee same-day delivery for a non-condolence order. Correct closing reply?
questions.question_zh: 客人问非帛事订单能否保证当天送达。正确结束回复？
options_en: No, we never deliver same day.
Give them a fixed delivery time you are not sure about.
Yes, we always deliver same day.
For non-condolence items it depends on stock and schedule. I can help confirm with the company. Tell me the date and budget if you want me to apply.
options_zh: 不行，我们从不当天送达。
给你一个你不确定的固定时间。
可以，我们总是当天送达。
非帛事视库存与排期。我帮你跟公司确认。如果你要申请，告诉我日期和预算。
questions.explanation_en: Do not promise what cannot be guaranteed. Offer to confirm and ask for date and budget.
questions.explanation_zh: 不承诺做不到的事。提议帮确认，并问日期和预算。
